observations: Flatcar CNCF icon files contain the project wordmark and are classified accordingly.
Original opaque backgrounds and native palette differences are retained and documented.
White/light ink can vanish on white and black/dark ink can vanish on dark backgrounds; choose the matching background.
Wordmarks and fine-detail marks remain legible only at larger sizes; nonempty rendering does not guarantee small-size readability.
Windows Server Microsoft wordmark is retained as a wordmark because no dedicated Iconify symbol was found; the unofficial Windows Server 2025 candidate was excluded.
